hiddenRule: 28 hidden on PSN: the 12 story/mission trophies, the 5 stranger-final trophies, Fair Game, the two VCIA trophies, and 8 secret-type trophies. Split matches the hidden/visible grade table published by OutputLag and eGamers (visible 27: 1 platinum, 1 gold, 6 silver, 19 bronze).

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum pops on its own once the last one lands.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the story through until the opening mission, Gone Fishing is complete; the trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play the story through until Chapter 1 is complete; the trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play the story through until Chapter 2 is complete; the trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play the story through until Chapter 3 is complete; the trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play the story through until Chapter 4 is complete; the trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Play the story through until the final mission is complete; the trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the story until the mission Breakfast Run is complete; the trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play the story until the mission The Cartel Heist is complete; the trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the story until the mission Child's Play is complete; the trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play the story until the mission Headliners is complete; the trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the story until the mission VCIA Takedown is complete; the trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play the story until the mission Operation Savage Glory is complete; the trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Finish the story first: the 100% Completion Checklist only appears afterwards, under Progress > Stats.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off stunts anywhere in Leonida: jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count toward the 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: the count is nine, per KeenGamer.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit the shooting ranges and work through all 42 challenges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Find the Top Fun drone races: there is one at each of 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Enter races across Leonida and win 20 different ones.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take Cal on in a fishing challenge and beat him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade machine and play a full arcade game through to its end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Find Andy's missions as they appear during the story and play each one when it shows.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Find Kenton's missions as they appear during the story and play each one when it shows.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Find Billy's missions as they appear during the story and play each one when it shows.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Play Strangers & Freaks mission strands as their icons appear across Leonida.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Find Randy's missions as they appear during the story and play each one when it shows.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Find Tyrone's missions as they appear during the story and play each one when it shows.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: FIRST, in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, check Jason's house in the morning. When Lucia says she will meditate, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting work: the trophy asks for one unique animal hunted for him.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect cards across Leonida and complete 3 full Collectible Card sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Open the WAiNK app and scan spots: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures count.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Open the Challenges list and complete any 50 of the 80 challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Build Combat Focus first: food, drinks or a shower at home help, and Adrenaline helps too.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Go to VCIA, the airport, and leave by an unscheduled route instead of a normal exit.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Find a Rhino tank and get into the situation the description hints at: it stays hot inside the Rhinos.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Pick a jewelry store and plan the robbery before going in.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Find the bank vaults and rob one, then escape cleanly.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road and rob it.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida until the whole map is covered.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Find the illegal operations run by each gang across Leonida.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach and enjoy a cocktail with the view, as the description says.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Go to a vehicle showroom and smash your way out in classic style, as the description says.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build the partnership the description hints at: a partnership with mass appeal.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Keep making choices as you play: the in-game count tracks them toward 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description says: second time's the charm. The trigger is a second attempt that succeeds.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The description asks what just happened: witness something strange in Leonida.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description asks for a melee drive-by that bowls someone over.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Collect Marked Bills, then launder them through your contacts.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend money across all shops in Leonida.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Find every garage property for sale across Leonida.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Open the Scooter Bros app and register vehicles to it.
